rationale: Fujia brings deep expertise in hardware systems for energy infrastructure, while Becky is a founding electrical engineer with hands-on embedded systems experience (Arduino, C++, Python). Their complementary hardware and electrical engineering backgrounds could create value if exploring intersections between power systems, infrastructure hardware, and embedded control — an area where Fujia's domain knowledge and Becky's engineering foundation could reinforce each other.
intro_message: Fujia Zhang, meet Becky — you both work on the hardware side of infrastructure; Fujia's background in solar and storage systems for data centers could offer useful perspective for Becky's embedded engineering work.
